title.narrative: Sustainability of Services for Key Populations in Eastern Europe and Central Asia ("EECA") - World - Multicountry HIV EECA APH (01-Jan-2022-31-Dec-2024)

description.narrative: Multicountry HIV EECA APH, HIV, International Charitable Foundation “Alliance for Public Health” (Alliance for Public Health)This program has the following goals: Сontribute to sustainable and significant reduction of infections, illness and death by HIV/AIDS in EECA region. The objectives of this program are: Institutionalizing effective models of and processes in HIV responses in EECA to impact HIV care cascade in the region. Removing barriers to services for key populations to promote quality health interventions based on human rights principles. Budget advocacy for sustainable services for key populations in EECA
